1804 is a leap year (divisible by 4, not a century exception).  
From 02-21 back 21 days → Feb 1.  
Remaining 145 − 21 = 124 days earlier.  
Jan has 31 days, so back 31 days → Dec 1, 1803.  
Remaining 124 − 31 = 93 days earlier.  
Count back: Nov 30 days → Nov 1 (93−30=63), Oct 31 days → Oct 1 (63−31=32), Sep 30 days → Sep 1 (32−30=2).  
Back 2 more days from Sep 1 → Aug 30, 1803.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1803-08-30
